def clean_up(path: str) -> None:
    p = Path(path).resolve()
    if not path or p in DISALLOWED or len(p.parts) <= 2:
        raise ValueError(f"Refusing to remove suspicious path: {p}")
    if not p.exists():

        print("Aborted.")
        return
    shutil.rmtree(p)
    print(f"Removed {p}")
